entries.title: Job 5:1
segments: ¶Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn? {turn: or, look?}

words.text: thee; and to which of the saints

entries.title: Job 5:2
segments: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one. {envy: or, indignation}

entries.title: Job 5:3
segments: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

entries.title: Job 5:4
segments: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither [is there] any to deliver [them].

entries.title: Job 5:5
segments: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

entries.title: Job 5:6
segments: ¶Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground; {affliction: or, iniquity}

entries.title: Job 5:7
segments: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward. {trouble: or, labour} {sparks...: Heb. the sons of the burning coal lift up to fly}

words.text: . {trouble: or, labour} {sparks...: Heb. the sons of the burning coal lift up to fly}

entries.title: Job 5:8
segments: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

entries.title: Job 5:9
segments: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number: {unsearchable: Heb. there is no search} {without...: Heb. till there be no number}

words.text: : {unsearchable: Heb. there is no search} {without...: Heb. till there be no number}

entries.title: Job 5:10
segments: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields: {fields: Heb. outplaces}

entries.title: Job 5:11
segments: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

entries.title: Job 5:12
segments: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform [their] enterprise. {their enterprise: or, any thing}

entries.title: Job 5:13
segments: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

entries.title: Job 5:14
segments: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night. {meet...: or, run into}

entries.title: Job 5:15
segments: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 5:16
segments: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

entries.title: Job 5:17
segments: ¶Behold, happy [is] the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

entries.title: Job 5:18
segments: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

entries.title: Job 5:19
segments: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

entries.title: Job 5:20
segments: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword. {power: Heb. hands}

entries.title: Job 5:21
segments: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh. {from...: or, when the tongue scourgeth}

entries.title: Job 5:22
segments: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:23
segments: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

words.text: For thou shalt be in league

entries.title: Job 5:24
segments: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle [shall be] in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin. {thy tabernacle...: or, peace is thy tabernacle} {sin: or, err}

words.text: . {thy tabernacle...: or, peace is thy tabernacle} {sin: or, err}

entries.title: Job 5:25
segments: Thou shalt know also that thy seed [shall be] great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth. {great: or, much}

entries.title: Job 5:26
segments: Thou shalt come to [thy] grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season. {cometh in: Heb. ascendeth}

words.text: , like as a shock of corn

entries.title: Job 5:27
segments: Lo this, we have searched it, so it [is]; hear it, and know thou [it] for thy good. {for...: Heb. for thyself}

words.text: thou [it] for thy good. {for...: Heb. for thyself}
